title: Carve 0.2 diagnostics catalog
description: Every code of the diagnostics record: the lint rules, the codes of the parse channel and of the render-loss channel, and the ids that 0.2 retires. Sorted by id.

id.description: The code. A code is a contract: it is not renamed and not reused.

clauses.description: The clauses that define the finding or name the code. A row that cites only C2-W-106 has no clause of its own: its finding keeps its 0.1 definition and the row stands in the catalog by that clause.

severity.description: The severity. Absent for a retired id.

channel.description: The one channel of the code (C2-W-104, C2-W-113). Absent for a retired id.

status.description: `kept`: an id of 0.1. `new`: new in 0.2. `renamed`: a rule of 0.1 under a new id, with the old one in `renamed_from`. `obsolete`: an id of 0.1 that 0.2 retires. `void`: a rule of the 0.2 design that a later ruling emptied.

renamed_from.description: The code. A code is a contract: it is not renamed and not reused.

replaced_by.description: The code. A code is a contract: it is not renamed and not reused.

default.description: The default state of a lint rule. `off`: the rule is opt-in and is turned on by its id (C2-W-109).

enabled_by.description: The option that selects the rule.

messages.description: The message texts. `${...}` stands for a value the engine fills in, and a word in parentheses in a text of the design stands for one too. A rule with several messages lists all of them.

message_notes.description: What the writer document says about the placeholders and variants of the messages.

message_origin.description: Where the texts come from. `engine_0_1`: the 0.1 reference engine, as the writer document copies them or as the engine reports them. `design`: the migrate and lint design, which the writer document names as the source for the new rules. `data_file`: written for this file, because the writer document asks for a 0.2 text and gives none.

reports.description: What the code reports, in the words of the writer document.

channel_reports.description: What the table of parse and render-loss codes says the code reports, where the rule also has messages.

change.description: What 0.2 changes for the rule, in the words of the writer document.
